name: c12e-check
description: Step C12e books check: 420 s at MAX (seed 5), the whole dish lit, a mineral spring and a vent plus other springs, N (60 s), a wash (100 s), a resize (150 s), G (200 s), a resize back (220 s), every C12e switch and knob off and on at runtime (250 to 350 s), a snapshot saved and loaded at once (380 s); atoms and charge rounding must stay 0

evals.js: const v = moire.control.view(); moire.matter.addSpring(v.cssW * 0.3, v.cssH * 0.35, 'soap', 120); moire.matter.addSpring(v.cssW * 0.5, v.cssH * 0.5, 'linker', 120); moire.matter.addSpring(v.cssW * 0.6, v.cssH * 0.3, 'ions', 120); moire.matter.addSpring(v.cssW * 0.4, v.cssH * 0.6, 'light', 1e9); return moire.matter.springs.length

const v = moire.control.view(); moire.matter.addSpring(v.cssW * 0.4, v.cssH * 0.4, 'light', 200); moire.matter.addSpring(v.cssW * 0.6, v.cssH * 0.6, 'heavy', 200); moire.matter.addSpring(v.cssW * 0.6, v.cssH * 0.4, 'ions', 200); return 1

{ const v = moire.control.view(); moire.matter.addSpring(v.cssW * 0.4, v.cssH * 0.5, 'light'); moire.matter.addSpring(v.cssW * 0.6, v.cssH * 0.5, 'heavy'); moire.matter.addSpring(v.cssW * 0.5, v.cssH * 0.3, 'ions'); } return moire.matter.springs.length
moire.waste.params.saturation = true; moire.waste.params.osmosis = false; return 'osmosis off'
moire.waste.params.osmosis = true; moire.waste.params.stretch = false; moire.waste.params.tear = false; moire.waste.params.cost = false; return 'stretch, tear, cost off'

moire.waste.params.stretch = true; moire.waste.params.tear = true; moire.waste.params.cost = true; moire.waste.params.kOsm = 80; moire.waste.params.wTol = 0.1; moire.waste.params.satScale = 5; return 'strong swelling, low tolerance, strong saturation'
moire.waste.params.kOsm = 10; moire.waste.params.wTol = 0.5; moire.waste.params.satScale = 1; moire.electrons.params.photolysis = false; return 'knobs back, photolysis off'
moire.electrons.params.photolysis = true; moire.membrane.params.on = false; return 'photolysis on, membrane chemistry off'
moire.membrane.params.on = true; moire.lipids.params.on = false; return 'lipids off'
moire.lipids.params.on = true; moire.light.params.mode = 'spot'; return 'all on, spotlight'
const S = await moire.snapshot({ grid: true }); const r = await moire.loadSnapshot(S); return { exact: r.exact, notes: r.notes, rounding: r.rounding }
